values.quickstart:
nix shell 'github:nix-purifiers/dhall-purifier'
dhall-purifier lock --file package.dhall
dhall-to-json --file package.dhall
values.language_tooling_setup: Start the supplied `dhall-lsp-server` wrapper from the prepared project environment. It uses the same integrity-checked semantic cache as `dhall` and `dhall-to-json`. Locked frontends are built without HTTP support. Use `dhall-purifier exec -- your-command` to pass the prepared environment to an editor process.
